title: Monteverdi's L'Orfeo premieres in Mantua
summary: Claudio Monteverdi's opera L'Orfeo, telling the myth of Orpheus, was first performed at the ducal court of Mantua.
reason: The Gonzaga court sponsored the new art of sung drama that Florentine composers had begun a few years earlier.
significance: It is the earliest opera still regularly performed and set the model for the form.
